values.note: 18 sites including one host site; paved roads and parking spurs, most averaging 32 ft.

sites.source: https://www.fs.usda.gov/r01/kootenai/recreation/bad-medicine-campground ('The campground has 18 sites including one host site, with tables and fire rings, most offering an average length of 32'. Campground roads and campsite parking spurs are paved.'), read 2026-10-22

values.note: The Forest Service description lists 'potable water, vault toilets and a fully developed boat ramp with dock', but its amenity list says 'Potable water is not available at this site'. Six day-use picnic sites by the ramp. A security gate is closed 10 pm - 7 am by the camp host.

facilities.source: https://www.fs.usda.gov/r01/kootenai/recreation/bad-medicine-campground ('Amenities include potable water, vault toilets and a fully developed boat ramp with dock', 'A security gate is closed at 10:00 pm and opened at 07:00 am daily be the camphost', amenity list 'Potable water is not available at this site'), read 2026-10-22

values.note: Forest Service: 'The campground is managed from May through September, but is available all year to visitors. Access is dependent upon weather conditions.'

season.source: https://www.fs.usda.gov/r01/kootenai/recreation/bad-medicine-campground (Operational Hours: 'The campground is managed from May through September, but is available all year to visitors. Access is dependent upon weather conditions.'), read 2026-10-22

note: Kootenai NF (Three Rivers RD) campground at the south end of Bull Lake, ~25 mi south of Troy on Hwy 56. Fully developed boat ramp with dock. --Claude
summary: Forest Service-run (Three Rivers RD). Confirmed $16 (2026), 18 sites incl. host, vault toilets; changed season year_round false->true (managed May-September, 'available all year to visitors'). Potable water left derived true: the page contradicts itself. Not stated: how sites are taken (no reservation link; not on recreation.gov), site max length (only a 32-ft average). Kootenai flood/washout alert lists no road to this campground. Note trimmed of restated values.
